market_view: Month-end session closing with VIX +4.78% and broad risk-off across Industrials, Healthcare, and small caps (IWM -0.97%) while Energy outperforms; SLV remains under pressure with the 61.5 short strike deep ITM and no close executed despite two consecutive CRITICAL alerts.

SLV 61.5/60.5p.reasoning: SLV at 59.875 keeps the 61.5 short strike 2.7% ITM; worst-case fill 0.70 is 1.27x credit with the 1.5x hard stop at 0.825 — this is the third consecutive CRITICAL alert with no close executed, and carrying this into overnight September 1 gap risk on a breached short strike is a rule violation.

SPY 738/728p.reasoning: DTE hits 21 on Thursday September 3 triggering the hard exit rule; current mid 0.905 vs 1.05 credit is only 14% profit, well below the 50% target, so rolling to October for net credit is the correct path rather than closing for a small win.

QQQ 679/670p.reasoning: QQQ at 714.45 sits 5.1% above the 679 short strike with 29 DTE and P&L essentially flat on an opening-day position — no rule triggered, structure is healthy.
